# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.2 — One AI option and resilient Announcement Hub routing

This release unifies the AI setting for direct Home Assistant delivery and Announcement Hub while adding a reliable system fallback.

## New
- **Single “Use AI for announcements” checkbox** in Announcements, retaining saved values from v0.2.1.
- When Announcement Hub is selected, `notify.announcement_hub` receives an explicit `use_ai: true` or `use_ai: false`. A chosen agent is passed as `ai_agent`; otherwise Hub keeps its configured default agent.
- Without Announcement Hub, the same checkbox enables conversational rewriting for native notification/TTS outputs.
- **The Announcement Hub option is shown only when the integration is configured**, not just because a service with that name happens to exist.
- Hub calls wait for the enqueue acknowledgement. Unavailable, stopped, rejected, timed-out and unroutable jobs use configured Home Assistant notification/TTS outputs instead. If those are unavailable, the advisor creates one persistent notification per room (visual fallback).
- Updated 38 languages, regression coverage and documentation.

## Behavior and limitations
The air-quality engine, window selection, warning policies, 90-second stable-open delay and the dashboard stay unchanged. AI does not choose windows. Original messages remain the fallback when AI rewriting fails validation.

The fallback is triggered on Hub submission problems; once the Hub accepts the job, later physical output retries are controlled by the Hub, preventing duplicates. A Home Assistant persistent notification cannot speak; configure direct fallback TTS engines and players if audible alerts must survive a Hub failure.

A conversation agent may have device-control capabilities or use a cloud service. Select an appropriately restricted agent. No config migration or device re-pairing is required.

## Update
Use **HACS → Air Quality Advisor → Update to v0.2.2**, then restart Home Assistant. In **Configure → Announcements** review the general AI checkbox and, if configured, the Announcement Hub setting. Existing sensor and dashboard entity IDs are preserved.
